summary.text: Ralph Ambrosio is the Republican and Conservative Party nominee for NY-20, having advanced unopposed after both primaries were canceled. According to his campaign website, he is a Navy veteran and attorney whose career included the New York State Police, county prosecution in Greene and Columbia counties, and the State Police counsel's office. He has not completed a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey.

paragraphs.text: Ambrosio was born in Hudson and raised in Chatham, NY; he served in the U.S. Navy (active duty and reserves) from 1970 to 1976 and graduated from Clarkson University.

He served with the New York State Police from 1977 to 1989 while earning his law degree, then worked as an Assistant District Attorney in Greene and Columbia counties (1989-1996), a public defender, and an assistant attorney general under Dennis Vacco, before returning to the State Police as Assistant Counsel from 1999 to 2010.
According to his campaign website, he retired from the State Police and moved into private practice, and has lived in Delmar, NY since 1985.
